decisions.reason: Restores 무공 and renders 창안된 as inspiration rather than inferred observation.
Same contrast in tighter English without the translated but-clause.
Safety equipment is the natural climbing equivalent of 안전장치.
빠꾸가 없지 is no backing down, not 'no half measures'; 'the Murim' is the established rendering.
Contraction matches Taekyung’s spoken narrator voice.
SOL turns 비현실적 into 'impossible'; BASE’s trailing 과언이 아니다 is stiff.
decisions.replacement: It had only seemed unrealistic because I’d never tried it before. It was no exaggeration to say my body had already entered the realm of the superhuman.

decisions.reason: Fussing 'what if' lands 어쩌려고 그러십니까 more naturally than calqued 'what will you do'.
'Fussed over me' is the right collocation for 호들갑을 떨며.
Preserves 대하듯 (as though I were) and the 삼대독자 image; SOL’s 'after three generations' is unclear.
SOL captures 자자 but replaces 이쯤 with unsupported 'today'.
decisions.replacement: “Come now. I think you should stop training for now and return to your quarters.”

decisions.reason: 'Fall again' is natural spoken English for 한 번 더 떨어지다.
Punchier 뭘 새삼스럽게 in Taekyung’s register.
눈빛 is gaze, not a body-part 'eyes' calque; 'darted' reads cleaner.
'Someone else has fallen' is more natural than 'there’s someone who’s fallen'.
뒤를 이었다 is sequential follow, not simultaneous accompaniment.
'Fell open' and 'dropped open' are indistinguishable.
'Never mind that' is the natural interrupt for 아니, 그 전에.
저걸 is dismissive 'that,' not 'him'.
성인 남성 and catching him as he falls (받아 들다) stay intact; SOL’s 'after a fall' and 'full-grown' drift.
Preserves 그냥 as 'just'.
They are pleading with Taekyung, so omitted subject is 'you,' not 'we'.
열 번도 더 is 'more than ten times,' not 'ten times over'.
SOL’s 'Besides' drops 하지만; BASE’s 'last moment' misses 한 끗 차이.
decisions.replacement: But Hyuk Mujin had a lifeline—a sturdy rope that always saved him by the narrowest of margins.

decisions.reason: Keeps 그 순간 as the instant the light flashes, not a separate beat.
Separate flash sentence is already merged into H024, matching the Korean period.
SOL’s meteor dive is cleaner, but 은은한 is soft, not faint.
decisions.replacement: It plunged downward as swiftly as a meteor, glowing with a soft purple light.

decisions.reason: 'Answered briefly' and 'gave a short answer' are equal; 짤막하게 대답했다 is already direct.
Avoids repeating the just-named technique without dropping the purple-qi image.
Drops the stiff 'when it came to ability' frame while keeping 넘사벽.
The dive is downward; 'shot forward' implies a horizontal burst.
내밀었다 is extending the palm, not thrusting it.
푹푹 파인다 is gouging, not the ground caving in.
'What it would look like' is the natural visual hypothetical for 이렇게 될까.
뒤집히고 is the ground flipping, not erupting; 신형 is a singular falling figure.
Preserves 땅을 밟았다 ('on the ground'); 'touched down' is aviation-toned.
어딜 봐서 is 'what part of that,' not a generic 'how exactly'.
알은체 is an acknowledging greeting, not merely noticing.
Deadpan 'I fell. Thanks to someone.' lets 누구 덕분에 land without added 'remember?'
지그시 노려봤다 is a direct steady glare; 'fixed with a glare' is stock-literary.
SOL’s 'owner of' is a 소유자 calque; BASE keeps the formal joke with less stiffness.
'Happy to hear' is more idiomatic than 'happy that you say'.
'Kept interfering' renders 훼방만 안 놨어도 without the awkward 'done anything but'.
Same rolling-rocks rebuke in tighter spoken English.
SOL’s 'well over' and 'hard enough' match 훌쩍 넘는/만만치 않은데, but 와르르 쏟아진다 is tumbling, not crashing.
decisions.replacement: Climbing a cliff well over a hundred jang high with your bare hands was hard enough. But every time I thought I’d made decent progress, rocks the size of children came tumbling down from above.

decisions.reason: 외침 is a cry/shout; 'warning' infers purpose.
Preserves Cheongpung’s wording 돌 굴러가요 ('rocks are rolling').
SOL drops 죽였다 ('to death') from the prayer-bead strangling.
들이받아 is charging/ramming, not a vague 'go at him'.
Cleaner dash clause for 손가락만 움찔거리던; 'sprang' already carries 벌떡.
Preserves the repeated 숨 쉬어, 숨.
고맙…… is cut off; BASE completes 'you'.
Keeps 무심코 as 'absentmindedly' and 우뚝 굳었다 as 'froze stiff'.
Glossary binds 사자후 as lion’s roar; BASE genericizes it.
'Went berserk' is the natural rendering of 눈이 뒤집혀 날뛰는.
Spoken sarcasm for 지금 몰라서 묻냐 without the calqued 'asking because'.
후다닥 물러난 is a scramble; 'scampered' fits Cheongpung better than 'hurriedly backed away'.
BASE’s 'so quickly that he looked' distorts 것처럼; SOL adds 'astonishing'.
decisions.replacement: Cheongpung vanished as quickly as if he’d been born walking on all fours. Hyuk Mujin sank to the ground.

decisions.reason: 눈에 맞았더라 has no intensifying 'right'.
'Blazed' compactly carries 이글이글 타올랐다.
설렁설렁한 is laid-back; SOL’s surface/inside split is cleaner.
Names the omitted subject as Cheongpung, which the next line confirms.
Keeps 청풍의 as the agent; 'ploy' and 'stoke' over-specify 끌어 올려.
자연인 is a wild/nature hermit, not merely 'nature-loving'; 출신 is 'from Huashan'.
'Whatever works' is the idiomatic 좋은 게 좋은 거지.
'Tossed to' is a handoff; 'threw at' sounds hostile.
'Keep it secure' matches 잘 챙겨 놔 better than 'keep that safe'.
이게 is 'this,' not 'it'.
'Replenishing hunger' is translationese; SOL splits hunger/energy naturally.
'Eat some' is the natural pill instruction.
낭떠러지 is a sheer drop, which is why there’s nowhere to eat.
More spoken retort for 단칼에 죽을걸.
Keeps the 북망산을 타고 pun (climb death-mountain with a climbing art).
Spoken coaching for 조급해하다가/천천히/한 번에 without losing the ledges.
섰을 때이다 is standing there, not 'had just taken our places'.
도 is 'too/also,' not 'still'.
Naturalizes 입을 열었다 as speaking, not a mouth-calque.
Preserves 라도 ('even an injury').
입장 is their position/perspective, not a 'plight'; 직장인들 is employees.
'Go ahead and report it. But…' grants permission while keeping the 단 cut-off.
'How much longer do you have?' is natural shift-talk for 얼마나 남았죠.
Same elapsed half-day in more natural English.
지긋지긋한 is 'damned'; 'the damned thing' fits the fed-up narrator.
SOL’s 'marks of time' matches 고스란히 맞아, but 'jagged' is not in 울퉁불퉁.
decisions.replacement: This tall, steep, nameless cliff bore the full marks of time. Some sections were uneven, while others were smooth.

decisions.reason: 뿌리나 is 'or,' not 'and'.
Places 'at least' on the verb, matching 하다못해 more naturally.
Rock crumbles (으스러진다); SOL makes Taekyung the agent and drops 도.
병장기 then plural 단검 is weapons, not a single weapon.
Drops the redundant 'the reason…was because' frame.
Both omit 귀신같이; BASE’s habitual 'would' and 'easier method' still needed.
decisions.replacement: Well, that was part of it. But every time I tried to use an easier method, Cheongpung would uncannily sense it and drop rocks on me.

decisions.reason: 투두두둑 is grit rattling down, not heavy thuds.
'Rock dust' and 'stone dust' are equal for 돌가루.
'Shielded' is the idiomatic verb for covering heads from falling debris.
Panic ellipsis ('Seriously, we didn’t!') is more natural than repeating 'do anything'.
Preserves 빼꼼 as a cautious peek; SOL adds 'over the edge'.
Keep the Konglish 스톤 샤워; SOL’s 흑역사 is better than 'humiliating memory'.
decisions.replacement: We weren’t even halfway. If we were hit by a stone shower and fell now, all the bold claims we’d made before climbing would become a dark stain on our past.

decisions.reason: 꼼수 as shortcuts and 얻어지는 as earned fit the training lecture.
'Magnanimously' captures 선심 쓴다는 듯이 without the extra 'one more sentence'.
The 상전 line is an exclamation; SOL’s shape is right but 'goddamn' is added profanity.
'Swallowed our outrage and resumed' is tighter for 분통을 참으며 다시.
Drops the Korean 'we were in a situation where' frame.
Preserves 이렇다 보니 as 'as a result' and 하나하나 as 'every single'.
Contraction and 'ages ago' match 진작 in narrator thought.
험난 is treacherous/harsh, not specifically steeper.
하루가 멀다고 is almost every day, not every few days; keeps 산발적으로.
'Dead end' is the natural climbing thought for 막혔다.
SOL matches 잘근잘근; BASE keeps 문득; neither has both.
decisions.replacement: As I worried at my lip, something suddenly caught my eye.

decisions.reason: Preserves 눈덩이 as a snowball; SOL genericizes to snow and adds 'solid'.
Keeps 작은 공간 and 힘들겠지만 ('difficult'), not the softened 'wouldn’t be easy'.
Source “흡!” is spoken, so quotes, not thought italics.
Preserves 동시에 and 정확히; SOL’s 'straight' is not precise.
Keeps 예상 and 눈덩이; 'punched through' overstates 뚫어 내다.
달하는 is amounting to 0.1 tons, not 'nearly'.
'Asking a bit much' is the idiomatic 좀 빡센데.
Preserves 고인 물기 as pooled moisture.
Keeps 긴장을 가라앉히다, 지지대, and 전신을 들어 올렸다; 'fulcrum' over-specifies.
Preserves 그야말로 as 'truly'.
Preserves 까지 as 'even' on the stat-up.
뻗으려던 그때였다 is the interrupted 'about to reach,' which SOL completes.
Source ‘흡!’ is interior thought, not speech.
가다듬는데 is overlapping action ('as I steadied'), not BASE’s 'but'.
Vision is obscured, not 'scattered'; sound can be scattered.
입을 떼다 is opening his mouth to speak, not specifically shouting.
위요 is 'Above!'; the 요 is politeness, not 'you'.
주춤 is a pause, and 귀가 뚫렸다 is ears opening; SOL invents a roar dying down.
Keeps 고개를 들어 and 마침내 목격했다 in one beat.
Inserted 'Then I saw it' splits a single 목격했다 and drops 마침내.
Preserves 줄이야 ('I can’t believe you broke…').
Completes the English idiom for 한 귀로 흘리고.
Keeps 아까만 해도 ('only a moment ago') and 저 자식 ('that bastard').
올라왔다 is 'made it up,' not a generic 'made it'.
손 하나 is a hand, not a finger; 정상을 짚었다 is reaching the summit, not 'over the edge'.
'Made it in one shichen' fits the climb-success line better than 'done it'.
'Panted with' is the natural collocation; 'at the waist' is redundant for 꾸벅 숙였다.
고생하셨습니다 is polite thanks for their hard work.
숨을 몰아쉬는 것도 잊고 is forgetting to pant, not merely to breathe.
저게 무슨 말이야 has no 'hell'.
설마 … 그건가 is still a dread question; SOL jumps to the next line’s denial.
아니겠지 is the brief 'No, surely not,' not 'He couldn’t'.
SOL adds 'perfect'; BASE’s 'opened my mouth' is an 입을 열었다 calque.
decisions.replacement: As an intellectual of modern society, I spoke with a calm demeanor.

decisions.reason: 이 자식은 is 'this bastard'; 자연인 stays 'wild man,' consistent with H063.
Preserves 나발이고 as 'or whatever'.
Neither candidate renders 똑같이 ('the same').
decisions.replacement: “And you’ll throw rocks at us from up here just the same?”

decisions.reason: 드러누웠다 is a protest flop, not collapsing from exhaustion.
내려갈 is going down, not specifically climbing down.
Preserves the source ellipsis in “……웃어?”
싱글벙글 is a beaming smile, not specifically a grin.
'Just like I did' is the natural English for seeing his former self.
SOL intensifies 재밌어서 to 'so much fun'; 안 따라 주 is 'wouldn’t keep up'.
Same 내게만 들릴 정도로 in tighter English.
행복한 과거 is a happy past; SOL’s 'fondly' moves the happiness onto the reminiscing.
Preserves 동시에; SOL drops the simultaneous burst.
Preserves 말을 이었다 as continued speaking, not a bare 'continued'.
Spoken Cheongpung; 'a moment' fits 잠깐만 and the ominous drop.
3평 is area ('in size'), not width; they are on a ledge.
Preserves 우리에게 ('at us') and 멍해 있는 as lying there in a daze.
